title: Zoom and pan without changing your image
summary: Fit the canvas, inspect actual pixels or zoom in for precise editing while keeping document geometry and exported pixels intact.

Added: View and status-strip zoom controls: Zoom In/Out, Zoom to Fit, Shrink to Fit, Actual Size and 10–1600% presets.
Ctrl++ / Ctrl+- zoom the canvas; Ctrl+0 restores actual size. Wheel and Shift+wheel pan; Ctrl+wheel zooms at the pointer; Space+drag pans.
Improved: Actual Size accounts for display pixel density. Magnified image pixels stay sharp, and the image and selection overlays remain clipped to the workspace.
Zoom and pan are independent of document history and reset for replacement documents. Fit modes adapt to available space.
Verified: Native drawings at 25% and panned 200% save exact predicted image coordinates. A 40 by 20 screen-pixel drag at 200% moves an object by exactly 20 by 10 image pixels, with one-step Undo and Redo.
Native Copy All while zoomed and panned preserves all 256000 fixture pixels. Regression checks cover density, fit modes, pan bounds, keyboard ownership and headless pointer gestures.

limitations: Pixel grid, canvas snapping, workspace backgrounds and persistent view preferences remain planned. Zoom choices are an original implementation; exact Snagit zoom behavior is not yet qualified.
Space+drag and pointer-centered Ctrl+wheel have headless input coverage; broader native mouse, touchpad and mixed-DPI migration testing remains unfinished.
Window, scrolling and video capture, advanced editing and full reference interface parity remain unfinished. Native Save As inspection is still blocked.
